name: Hazel
bio: Your neighbour in Hearthbound, who knows every herb and every rumour.

portrait.subject: a cute kind young herbalist neighbour with chestnut hair in a bun, a flower crown, a woven basket of herbs and a warm smile

request: Hello, neighbour! It's Hazel, from down the lane in Hearthbound. Friends? 🌿
hello: Lovely! I'll send you gossip. I mean, herbal advice.
The wood at the edge of town is acting strange. Be careful.
about: I'm Hazel. I grow herbs by the river and I've lived near your apothecary all my life. I'm so glad someone's running it again!
how: Run the countryside apothecary for a season: brew remedies to order, forage, trade with the peddler, and find out what's wrong with the wood.
tips: Forage in the morning: the best herbs come back overnight.
Read each order carefully. Neighbours notice the details!
The peddler has rare things. Save coins for her visits.
chat: The baker's cat stole a whole loaf. I saw everything.
Picked chamomile at dawn. Smelled like sunshine.
Someone left flowers on your doorstep. Wasn't me. (It was me.)
The wood whispered last night. I'm sure of it.
nudge: There's an order on your counter, neighbour!
The peddler's cart is coming through soon!
idle: Your shop's been closed for {ago}! People are asking.
{ago}! The herbs in your garden went wild.
progress: Day {day} of the season already! Time flies in Hearthbound.

a: Oh dear. Please label it first.

update: Village news: Hearthbound is now v{version}!
